meta.note: Blue counted as one corridor with Line 3 (main) + Line 4 (branch). Magenta has two disconnected operational segments. Network covers four operators: DMRC (9 corridors), NMRC Aqua Line, NCRTC Namo Bharat and Meerut Metro, and Rapid Metro Gurugram (HMRTC).
